# Project Governance 4.6.0

## Cowork development on your Mac

A distributable Claude Desktop plugin connects Cowork to a registered Mac checkout and its pinned Governance runtime. It supports native task continuation, focused context, file edits, detached checks and local commits through normal hooks. No Codex installation is required.

The plugin ships as a separate version-matched ZIP. Each teammate registers their own checkouts locally; the package contains no machine-specific paths or project registration data. Registration explains that native checks and hooks execute project code and returned text enters Claude. Claude's own permissions remain in effect.

File edits verify original hashes and task scope. Check and commit IDs survive reconnects. A rejected commit returns its diagnostics; an uncertain result is inspected without automatically resubmitting it. Unrelated staged work is preserved.

## Installation

Install the runtime through the normal pinned-archive process. Register the intended checkout with `project-governance cowork register`, then install the matching plugin ZIP through Claude Desktop. Repeat registration after an intentional runtime upgrade or checkout move. Publication does not upgrade existing projects.

## Qualification and boundaries

This release follows the normal local qualification and manual publication process. GitHub CI is not used. Synthetic installed-package and Claude Desktop journeys are controlled tests, not evidence of customer outcomes or token savings. The plugin does not expose arbitrary shell commands, device operations, deployment, or remote publication.
